title: Nolantic Shader
description: A Modern Minecraft Shader for Minecraft 1.20.1
body:

### FAQ

1. "Will this shader work on older or newer Minecraft versions?"
   * Yes! Nolantic is built to be modern and highly compatible. As long as your shader loader (like Iris) runs on your Minecraft version, Nolantic should work perfectly without issues.

2. Q: Why does the Discord Link leads me to HBM Modernized Server? A: The Shader is a Side Work from the HBM Modernized Mod and belongs to the Mod. 

3. Q: Why is the Shader Buggy? A: The Shader is currently in Work in Progress and also my First Time making one. 
---

## Features

* **Cinematic Atmospheric Warmth:** Specially tuned light-scattering models that transform ordinary golden hours into a deep, dense, amber-tinted sunset experience.
* **Organic Light Bleeding:** Low-angle sunlight naturally washes over block edges and terrain, softening harsh pixelated contrasts for a incredibly clean, cinematic look.
* **Advanced Volumetric Fog:** Thick, realistic low-altitude fog layers that organically catch the color of the sun and scatter light realistically across the horizon.
* **Warm Ambient Shadows:** No more cold, pitch-black shadow voids. Ambient occlusion and shading are physically tied to the time of day, ensuring shadows retain a rich, warm, realistic bounce-light undertone.
* **High-Fidelity Water System:** Custom water rendering featuring accurate Fresnel reflections—offering crystalline, deep turquoise depths close up, shifting to a striking, bright gloss at distant viewing angles.
* **Dynamic Screen-Space Reflections (SSR):** Crisp, real-time reflections on water surfaces and wet materials.
* **Smooth Variable Penumbra Shadows:** Realistic, soft shadow filtering where edges diffuse naturally based on distance from the light source.

---

## Compatibility

### Shader Loaders

* **Iris (Highly Recommended)**
  * Tailored for Iris to ensure maximum performance, frame stability, and full access to advanced rendering features.
* **OptiFine**
  * Supported for standard configurations.

### Hardware & Performance

* Optimized for **Nvidia**, **AMD**, and **Intel** dedicated graphics.
* Designed as a premium, semi-realistic shader profile that balances breath-taking, card-melting visuals with excellent frame stability for daily gameplay.
